baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verb ءَاثَرَ governs الحياة الدنيا as the selected object.
baseline_models.mechanism: A deliberate act of preference ranks the life designated as near or first above an unspoken rival.

activation_trace.role: Preference by choice supplies the verse's explicit ranking operation.
Living existence supplies the object whose mode is being ranked.
The near, smaller, or first sphere specifies the selected life as الدنيا.

changed_reading.before: The clause merely names attachment to worldly life.
changed_reading.after: The clause depicts an active ranking in which the near life is deliberately put ahead of an implied alternative.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: الحياة and الدنيا can be combined as beneficial life made attractive by proximity.
baseline_models.mechanism: The chosen object is not only an era called 'the world'; it is life experienced as immediately reachable benefit and good.

activation_trace.role: Preferential selection directs value toward one available object.
Life as benefit or good gives the selected object a use-value dimension.
Proximity makes that benefit experientially close and available.

changed_reading.before: The subject prefers a conventionally named worldly domain.
changed_reading.after: The subject selects the good that is close enough to possess and enjoy now.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ء ث ر inventory places preference beside استئثار, while the object is beneficial but lower life.
baseline_models.mechanism: Preference shades into taking the immediately beneficial sphere for oneself, excluding the rival claim of a higher or later good.

activation_trace.role: Self-appropriation supplies an exclusionary edge to the act of choosing.
Life as benefit identifies what is appropriated.
Lowness or diminished rank marks the quality of the benefit chosen.

changed_reading.before: The act is a neutral comparison between two objects.
changed_reading.after: The act is an exclusionary appropriation of lower benefit for the self.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening movement from going ahead to managing an affair's outcome turns preference into an ordering problem: the subject puts the near life first without giving its aftermath governing weight.

activation_trace.role: Putting a thing first anchors preference as priority-setting.
Proximity identifies what receives first place.
Advancing and racing supply the ordered image of one concern moving ahead of another.
Managing by considering the outcome supplies the afterview missing from near-first preference.

structural_cues: The opening fā-sequence moves from going ahead in 79:4 to تدبير an affair in 79:5.
The focus clause makes الدنيا, the near object, the winner of a ranking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies precedence and outcome-aware management; I infer a contrast between putting the near first and governing by aftermath. The opening agents may instead be unrelated to the human choice mechanism.

changed_reading.after: He made nearness the rule of priority and thereby ranked without adequate regard for outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated boundary-crossing of Pharaoh develops through turning away, purposeful exertion, and a claim to highest lordship; its immediate restatement before 79:38 makes preference for near life the practical economy of self-sovereignty, not an isolated appetite.

activation_trace.role: Self-appropriation lets preference participate in a regime centered on the chooser.
Life as benefit identifies the goods organized around that regime.
Exceeding the limit introduces the governing pattern in Pharaoh's story.
Turning one's back makes the pattern an enacted refusal rather than a private judgment.
Purposeful movement toward a desired end makes transgression programmatic.
The claim of lordship supplies the sovereignty being seized for the self.
Self-exalting greatness intensifies the claim into supremacy.
The repeated limit-crossing directly frames the focus clause as its paired conduct.

structural_cues: 79:37 and 79:38 are coordinated predicates under the first فَأَمَّا construction.
The earlier Pharaoh sequence supplies a concrete enactment of the repeated طغى.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated transgression, active striving, and claimed lordship; I infer that preferring near-life goods is the value-system sustaining self-rule. A live alternative is that the Pharaoh narrative is only an example of طغيان, while 79:38 names an independent vice.

changed_reading.before: Preference for worldly life is a private material attachment.
changed_reading.after: Preference for near-life benefit is the operating value-system of boundary-crossing self-sovereignty.

context_deltas.mechanism: The raised heaven and its held-up structure are set against earth as the lower counterpart; within that architecture, selecting الدنيا becomes a downward valuation, not only a choice of the temporally immediate.

activation_trace.role: Preference supplies the act that assigns superior value.
Lowness or diminished rank permits the spatial contrast to become evaluative.
Height and elevation establish the upper pole of the created order.
Raising makes vertical differentiation an explicit operation.
The overhead structure that holds a building gives the upper realm material coherence.
Earth as the lower counterpart to heaven establishes the lower pole.

structural_cues: 79:27-30 moves from constructing and raising heaven to spreading earth.
The focus adjective الدنيا can therefore carry temporal proximity and activated vertical rank together.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an upper/lower cosmic arrangement and a focus branch of diminished rank; I infer that choosing الدنيا is a downward valuation. The adjective may still primarily mark temporal nearness rather than physical altitude.

changed_reading.before: He chose the life available sooner.
changed_reading.after: He assigned supremacy to the lower terrestrial tier within a deliberately raised and ordered cosmos.

context_deltas.mechanism: Water and pasture are brought out as enjoyable provision for humans and livestock. This activates الحياة as rain-fed terrestrial vitality and benefit, so the error becomes converting a supported means of life into the terminal object of preference.

activation_trace.role: Preference converts provision from a usable means into the dominant end.
Earth's life through rain and vegetation links the focus noun to the preceding ecology.
The near sphere locates that ecology in الدنيا.
Bringing a thing out of concealment supplies the production step for terrestrial resources.
Water supplies the material condition of the activated life-system.
Pasture and grazing supply the biological yield of that water.
Enjoyable utility identifies the created system as provision for use.
Livestock wealth marks the shared creaturely economy served by the provision.

structural_cues: The creation sequence culminates in 79:33 with متاعا لكم ولأنعامكم.
The overwhelming event in 79:34 immediately limits that provisioned order.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a rain-pasture-benefit chain; I infer that the fault is absolutizing its use-value rather than using the provision as provision. A live alternative is that 79:38 condemns attachment to duration generally, without distinguishing means from ends.

changed_reading.before: Worldly life is an abstract temporal domain that is preferred.
changed_reading.after: A rain-fed, pasture-producing economy of real benefit is mistaken for the final end it was never said to be.

context_deltas.mechanism: The two outcomes are symmetrically named as places one joins for shelter. Preference in 79:38 therefore acquires a path-and-destination shape: what is followed and favored in the near sphere terminates in a settled affiliation.

activation_trace.role: Following in a prior track lets preference be modeled as path adherence.
The close sphere is the path's present segment rather than its terminus.
Intensely blazing fire supplies one terminal environment.
Joining a gathering place supplies the relation between traveler and terminal shelter.
A garden enclosed by vegetation supplies the contrasting terminal environment.
The repeated joining relation makes both alternatives destinations of affiliation.

structural_cues: 79:39 and 79:41 repeat the exact predication هِيَ الْمَأْوَى around the opposing human responses.
The focus choice stands directly before the first destination statement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two symmetric shelters after two opposed responses; I infer a path from present preference to eventual affiliation. The alternative is a simpler forensic sequence in which the shelters are consequences without path imagery in ءَاثَرَ itself.

changed_reading.before: Preference is exhausted in the present act of choosing.
changed_reading.after: Preference is the present segment of a route that ends in joining one of two shelters.

context_deltas.mechanism: The parallel alternative anticipates standing before the Lord and restrains the inner self from its inclination. This diagnoses the focus preference as a failure of inner governance: desire is allowed to set the ranking in favor of what is near.

activation_trace.role: Preference is the ranking operation whose governor must be identified.
Proximity explains why desire's selected object exerts immediate pull.
Expectation of a feared outcome extends valuation beyond present proximity.
A station or standing supplies the accountability horizon before which choice is made.
Lordship relocates governing authority outside the desiring self.
Restraint supplies the active counter-operation to ungoverned preference.
The inner faculty identifies the site at which competing rankings are managed.
The self's inclination supplies the directional appetite opposed to restraint.

structural_cues: The وَأَمَّا clause in 79:40 is grammatically parallel to the فَأَمَّا clause containing 79:38.
The opposing actions are preferring near life and restraining the self from inclination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a parallel counter-action, an inner inclination, and an accountability horizon; I infer that desire governs the focus ranking when restraint is absent. Fear may alternatively denote reverent awe rather than primarily anticipation of consequence.

changed_reading.before: The subject makes an unexplained bad choice between two lives.
changed_reading.after: The near life wins because inner inclination is permitted to govern valuation instead of being restrained under accountability.

context_deltas.mechanism: When the awaited event is seen, the preceding stay contracts in perception to an evening or morning. Proximity thus becomes a scale error: a short interval receives the preference appropriate to an enduring horizon.

activation_trace.role: Preference supplies the valuation that distorted temporal scale affects.
Lived existence is the interval being overvalued.
Nearness supplies the short-horizon bias exposed by later perception.
A bounded duration establishes the unit against which the stay is compressed.
Actual seeing triggers the retrospective recalibration of duration.
Remaining in a place supplies the interval now perceived as brief.
Evening supplies one edge of the compressed part-day comparison.
The morning span supplies the other part-day measure.

structural_cues: 79:42 asks about the Hour, while 79:46 closes by compressing prior duration once it is seen.
The final simile supplies a retrospective scale unavailable to the chooser in 79:38.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visual arrival and perceived brevity; I infer that preference for الدنيا is temporal mispricing. The compressed stay may refer specifically to postmortem waiting rather than the whole earthly life, which limits the strength of the direct link.

changed_reading.before: The near life is wrongly preferred because it is morally lower.
changed_reading.after: The near life is also mispriced because the interval that feels dominant now will retrospectively contract to part of a day.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because active ءَاثَرَ ordinarily expresses preference, not the nominal أثر left behind. It remains valid as a same-root branch overlay sharpened by remembered striving and exposed consequence; downstream prose should say that the preference becomes traceable in conduct, not translate the verb as 'left a trace.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root ء ث ر includes the branch of a remaining sign that indicates what occurred.

activation_trace.role: A lasting mark supplies the exploratory idea that preference leaves inspectable residue.
Bringing something back to mind supplies retrospective recovery of the residue.
Work and acquisition make the inward ranking legible through accumulated conduct.
Exposure makes what was consequentially hidden visible.
Seeing completes the forensic movement from hidden preference to manifest result.

changed_reading.before: Preference is an inward choice known only at the moment of decision.
changed_reading.after: Preference deposits a behavioral trace that can later be remembered, exposed, and seen.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is highly form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant ث و ر mapping for the focus root rather than the ordinary preference sense. The split inventory and the story's overflowing, directed exertion keep it anchored as an associative activation; downstream prose must label it exploratory and must not present 'stirred up' as a translation of ءَاثَرَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet maps focus ء ث ر not only to ء ث ر but also to ث و ر, whose branches include stirring a thing from its place.

activation_trace.role: Stirring and moving a thing from its place supplies the strange mobilization overlay.
Life as benefit identifies the resources being mobilized.
The near sphere bounds the project being energized.
Directed movement toward a desired end gives the stirring a practical trajectory.
Overflowing like water supplies the excessive force of that mobilization.

changed_reading.before: The subject passively favors the life already at hand.
changed_reading.after: Associatively, the subject stirs the near-life economy into an active, overflowing project ordered around desired benefit.

strongest_changes: The creation sequence turns abstract 'worldly life' into a concrete rain-pasture-benefit system that is wrongly made terminal.
The Pharaoh sequence and the parallel counter-choice recast preference as desire-governed self-sovereignty rather than private consumption alone.
The raised-heaven/lower-earth architecture activates a vertical misvaluation alongside temporal nearness.
The closing part-day comparison exposes preference for الدنيا as a possible error of temporal scale.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package let opening priority, Pharaoh's political self-rule, cosmic provisioning, paired shelters, inner restraint, and final time-compression alter the same three-word clause without forcing those mechanisms into one reading. It also preserved contained ء ث ر trace and ث و ر stirring overlays that a conservative synthesis would likely suppress.
remaining_uncertainties: The activated senses of الدنيا as temporally near, spatially lower, and evaluatively diminished can coexist, but the clause alone does not rank them.
The compressed stay in 79:46 may be earthly life or specifically the interval before resurrection.
The forensic-trace and stirring readings should remain associative overlays, not lexical substitutions for ءَاثَرَ.
